text:
Aisha: quick brainstorm 1 Adaptive Guidance (Lite) under Optimize toolkit: offline batching + cache TTL recs, conservative quant profiler, eval-triggered alerts. want scope + launch gates.
Marco: keep MVP read-only recommendations (no auto-tuning). much safer and reduces infra.
Eve: +1. define customer personas: payments (low-latency), embed-heavy (throughput), platform teams (ops). tag recs by persona.
Kai: infra: sampler -> model-profile DB -> cost-model. sampling must match seq-len dist. expect small k8s job + object storage.
Ruth: compliance: private customers get a runner container; hosted gets hashed prompt signatures only. default = no raw prompts leave.
Aisha: UX: one CSV with route, action, est_monthly_savings_usd, confidence, risk_note, validation_steps. UI: summary card + expand for examples.
Marco: API (read-only):
POST /v1/optimize/lite/analyze
{ "route": "checkout/complete", "lookback": "72h", "persona": "payments" }
Response: { "analysis_id":"aid_123", "summary":[{"action":"increase_batch","value":8,"savings_usd":120.5,"confidence":0.65,"risk":"may spike single-token latency"}], "report_url":"/reports/aid_123.csv" }
Eve: add validation checklist: sample prompts to rerun, target metrics, acceptable deltas (e.g., eval concordance <= 3% drop).
Kai: alerts: perf alerts (p95 up, tokens/sec down) and quality alerts (embedding drift, eval concordance). run mini-eval on canaries every 15m.
Ruth: security gate: any alert including prompt content must be opt-in for hosted. default = no prompt text.
Aisha: acceptance criteria draft:
- recs for 3 archetypes from 72h sample
- >=8% token/runtime savings for >=1 pilot customer without >3% eval degradation
- alerts surface quality regressions within 30m
- private-runner container that doesn't export raw prompts
Marco: timeline (rough): spec+data contract 10d, sampler+reporter 3w, scoring+cost-model 2w, eval hooks 2w, pilot weeks 8-10.
Kai: infra ask: 1 infra eng (0.5 FTE) + 1 ML infra (0.5 FTE); storage ~$1k/mo.
Ruth: I'll draft pilot intake template listing telemetry, privacy knobs, SLOs.
Aisha: risks: quant profiling offline misses long-tail prompts. mitigation: "safe-q4" preset + A/B validation checklist.
Eve: UX: show top 3 signals that drove the rec and a one-click opt-in for alerts. include revert instructions.
Marco: measure user-visible quality via customer eval sets + small human-check for payments.
OpsBot: ops-bot: created ticket OPT-LITE-17 "Adaptive Guidance (Lite) MVP spec" assigned to Aisha, Kai, Marco, Eve.
Aisha: next steps: Marco -> cost & model equations by 2026-04-05; Kai -> sampler prototype + schema by 2026-04-05; Eve -> eval suite + alert defs by 2026-04-07; Ruth -> pilot intake doc by 2026-04-07.
Kai: ack, will post infra sketch here.
Ruth: ack, will loop in PMM for pilot comms.
Aisha: will convert thread into working spec and ping reviewers. thanks everyone.
